#009 · Shellfish Pokémon

Blastoise

Water

Kanto · Generation 1

Blastoise is a Water-type Shellfish Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1.6 m tall and weighs 85.5 kg. It evolves from Wartortle. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (105), with a base stat total of 530.
